newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian OLO/Bund spread seen stable ahead auction.
newsitem.headline: Belgian OLO/Bund spread seen stable ahead auction.

text.p: Belgian linear bonds' midday losses widened in late Wednesday trading after T-bonds fell half a point on stronger than expected U.S. economic indicators, but OLOs held out better than the U.S. market in line with Bunds.

OLO futures were down 14 bp at 120.39 after touching 120.27. Chartists saw no strong support or resistance lines nearby, but again pointed to U.S. T-bond futures which are close to a key support line at 106.
The OLO/Bund spread was stable at 12 bp, and economists saw little reason for it to change ahead of the monthly linear bond auction on Monday.
